_note: Fiscal/accounting year = C_Year, with its periods as children (C_Period). Keyed by FiscalYear (the year string, e.g. '2026') - unique per calendar, so if multiple calendars share a year value the key is ambiguous (use a single calendar, or filter). 'calendar' is the parent C_Calendar (required). Periods can be created here, or auto-generated in Onfinity via the Create Periods process.

fields.help: the accounting calendar this year belongs to

createPeriods.label: Create the calendar periods for this year (auto-generates the standard monthly periods)

params.name: Month_ID
params.help: optional specific month; omit to create the full set of periods

createPeriods._note: Record-bound process on C_Year. For this keyScoped entity, pass 'calendar' in the body so the right year is selected, e.g. POST /v1/FiscalYear/2026/actions/createPeriods { "calendar": "OMEGO Calendar" }.
